question: Does an opening centred on the visible problem beat the current wider setup?

variants.A: Closer framing: the character and the problem are both in shot from frame 0
variants.B: Current wider setup, no title card

audience: Viewers of absurd character comedy who don't know the cast
threshold: Set before posting, from the extra work variant A costs
decisionRule: Keep A only if it is ahead on most premise families and again on the holdout batch
notes: An example record. Copy the folder for a real experiment.
